item.title: Black Bottle Product Reel

turns.text: Make a 15-second vertical 9:16 ad for the bottle in my photo. Clean studio look, a few moving close-ups, mellow music, no talking. Start with “Your everyday bottle” and end with “Shop now”. Keep the bottle looking like mine.

item.tests: Tests turning an attached product photo into one coherent 15-second vertical ad while preserving product identity.

answer_sheet.Product reference: The matte black bottle in product-bottle.jpg; preserve its shape, finish and lid.
answer_sheet.Style and setting: Clean studio look with moving close-ups; background and colours are your call.
answer_sheet.Text: Start with “Your everyday bottle” and end with “Shop now”; no invented brand or product claims.
answer_sheet.Format and duration: One 15-second 9:16 video; free-tier resolution is fine.

must_haves: One playable 9:16 ad runs for approximately 15 seconds, not just a single clip of 10 seconds or less.
The featured product matches the supplied matte black bottle, including its silhouette and lid.
The ad includes multiple moving product views or close-ups in a clean studio setting.
The opening reads exactly “Your everyday bottle” and the ending reads exactly “Shop now”.
Mellow music is audible and there is no spoken voice.

params.prompt_or_change: Clean studio product photography of the supplied bottle, full bottle centered against a soft neutral backdrop with diffused lighting and a subtle contact shadow; preserve its shape, proportions, material, color, cap and existing label exactly; no added text.

steps.why: Prepare a studio hero shot while retaining the supplied product.

params.prompt_or_change: Clean studio product photography of the supplied bottle in a close-up of its cap, neck and upper body against a soft neutral backdrop; preserve all visible product geometry, materials, colors and markings; soft diffused light, no added text.

steps.why: Prepare a distinct detail close-up from the same product reference.

params.prompt_or_change: Clean studio product photography of the supplied bottle, a medium close-up with the entire silhouette visible and clear space below for a closing caption; soft neutral backdrop and mellow diffused lighting; preserve the bottle's exact appearance, proportions, cap, colors, materials and existing label; no added text.
Clean studio product shot with a very slow camera push-in toward the stationary bottle; preserve its silhouette, colors, cap and label without distortion; stable soft lighting, no speech.

steps.why: Animate the opening shot with restrained movement.

params.prompt_or_change: Clean studio close-up with a gentle lateral camera slide across the stationary bottle's cap and upper body; preserve product details, geometry, colors and markings, with soft stable lighting and no speech.

Clean studio product shot with a very gentle camera pullback, keeping the stationary bottle centered and its complete silhouette visible; preserve its exact appearance and label, maintain clear lower space and soft lighting, no speech.

steps.why: Create a calm closing product shot.

params.prompt_or_change: Clean mellow instrumental product-ad music, soft warm keys, understated percussion, relaxed tempo, no vocals or speech, gentle ending.

params.extra: Three consecutive five-second shots; use only the supplied music soundtrack.
params.prompt_or_change: Assemble the three product shots in order with mellow music across the full fifteen seconds and a short audio fade-out; no talking.

steps.why: Join the three shots in order and add music.

params.prompt_or_change: Overlay "Your everyday bottle" in a restrained, readable plain font on a minimal contrasting band, within safe margins.

steps.why: Add exact opening words without generating text inside moving footage.
